title: Carrier and support agree up to H^n-null sets when spt V has positive density (Simon 4.10(1), Ch. 1 3.6)
statement: Let U be any subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure) with weight mu. Suppose every xi in spt V = U cap spt mu has a positive density: there is a real t > 0 with mu(B_r(xi))/(omega_n r^n) -> t as r -> 0+ (V.HasDensity xi t). Then H^n(M symmetric-difference spt V) = 0, where H^n = muHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ x ∈ V.support, ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ V.HasDensity x t) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff V.carrier V.support) = 0
